hooks.command: payload=$(cat); case "$payload" in *Label3D*|*TextMesh*) printf '%s' "$payload" | powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/scripts/agent/guard-edit.ps1";; esac
payload=$(cat); case "$payload" in *commit*) printf '%s' "$payload" | powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/scripts/agent/check-staged.ps1" -Hook;; esac
